author: swarajspd90
quote:
This is not What GTA games used to be. This game is too boring and I'm regretting my decision to buy this game on day one. If i had waited for people's reviews I would not have bought this game. 
This game is such a shame to GTA franchise. There is no fun in this game. You can't steal and drive cars. You can't shoot in the clubs. The missions in this game are so lame, they don't even feel like main missions. Fix this game or I'll uninstall it soon. 
This is doesn't allow you to have fun.
